init(
    selectedId: Binding<Quake.ID?>,
    selectedIdMap: Binding<Quake.ID?>,
    searchDate: Date = .now,
    searchText: String = ""
) {
    _selectedId = selectedId
    _selectedIdMap = selectedIdMap

    _quakes = Query(
        filter: Quake.predicate(
            searchText: searchText,
            searchDate: searchDate),
        sort: \.magnitude,
        order: .reverse
    )
}
